errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse zeigt die verschiedenen Indikatoren... Die vertikale Achse stellt die Werte dar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the vertical axis shows the categories (Indikatoren) and the horizontal axis shows the values.

errors.text_span: wobei die Ticks alle 1,5 Einheiten angeben
errors.evidence: The value axis does not have any numerical tick marks or labels. There is only a central line at the zero value.

errors.text_span: Der längste Balken, der dem Indikator NEWK OECD vs. 55 entspricht
errors.evidence: The longest bar corresponds to the indicator 'NEWK COM vs. 37' with a value of 9,5, not 'NEWK OECD vs. 55' which has a value of 7,8.
The chart label is 'NEWK COM vs. 37', not 'NEWK VP COM vs. 37'.
The description completely omits the category 'REWK-LSK COM vs. 37' and its corresponding value of 5,3.

errors.text_span: Der Balken NEWK VP COM vs. 37 erreicht einen Wert von 9,5.
errors.evidence: The value of 9,5 corresponds to the category 'NEWK COM vs. 37', but the description incorrectly attributes it to the non-existent category 'NEWK VP COM vs. 37'.
